_note: Camera per landscape in map tiles (x right/east, y down/south). heading: north|northeast|...|degrees (0 = map up). elevation: base ground height per landscape in tiles; water is 0.

shallow_water.heading: east
shallow_water.composition: Standing in turquoise shallows off the north beach, looking east along the coast. Left half: open deep-blue sea to the horizon. Right half: a long pale-sand beach curving away into the distance with palm trees behind it; further along the shore, the red extractor and its pipe scaffold reaching into the sea. Far right: green forest canopy rising inland.

north_beach.heading: west
north_beach.composition: On the sand of a long beach, looking west along the shoreline. Centre and right: the sea, turquoise near the shore and deep blue beyond; on the far-right horizon, Pleasure Island. Left midground: the red extractor and its pipe scaffold out over the shallows, palm trees and a driftwood log on the sand. Left edge: green meadow inland.

arrival_plains.heading: north
arrival_plains.composition: A grassy meadow looking north. Centre midground: Sylvie's cottage inside a low wooden picket fence, a small garden and a few giant mushrooms in front, pine trees either side. Behind it a pale beach, then the sea; on the horizon centre-left, Pleasure Island. Foreground: open grass and a round green bush.

forest1.heading: east
forest1.composition: At the western edge of a dense forest, looking east into it. Left: a sandy path and the red extractor's roof toward the beach. Centre and right: a thick canopy of rounded deciduous and pine trees stretching away, giant red-capped and blue mushrooms between the trunks, the ground rising gently toward the central plateau. Far right: grey stone ruins above the treeline.

murky_water.heading: southwest
murky_water.composition: Looking down into a sunken swamp: dark still pools with lily pads and cattails, divided by raised grassy banks with crumbling stone ledges, gnarled dark swamp trees and a dead red tree, a wooden chest on a small islet. Beyond, the land ends in low cliffs; on the far-left horizon across the sea, the glacier island.

veres_hill.heading: north
veres_hill.composition: On a high stone plateau, looking north at Veres' mesa rising straight ahead: a dark cave mouth at its base, a wooden ladder up its side, a small campfire nearby. Left and right: lavender-grey stone terraces and pine trees. Far beyond, the forest falls away to the north coast and the sea, with Pleasure Island on the far-left horizon.

south_land.heading: east
south_land.composition: A southern lowland meadow, looking east. Left: the land climbs in the central plateau's terraced cliffs, topped with pine forest. Centre: rolling green meadow with scattered boulders running toward the coast. Right: low cliffs drop to the sea; across the water, the glacier island.

unknown_hills.heading: south
unknown_hills.composition: On a high rocky hillside at the south edge of the main island, looking south over the sea. Foreground: lavender-grey rock and sparse grass falling away. Midground: across a channel of turquoise water, a snow-covered island with blue ice cliffs and a frozen pool ringed by ice. Far right: more of the glacier coast.

mountain_forest.heading: southeast
mountain_forest.composition: Mountain forest on the western slopes of the central plateau, looking southeast. Foreground: lavender-grey stone terraces, carved stone stairs leading down, purple-leaved shrubs. Midground: pine trees and grassy ledges stepping down. Far: the sea, and the glacier island on the horizon.

stormy_water.heading: northwest
stormy_water.composition: Out on open sea in a violent storm, looking northwest. Huge dark waves in the foreground. Midground: Pleasure Island, its cliffs lashed by surf, a rowing boat tied at its foot. Dark storm clouds, lightning, sheets of rain.

northeastern_sea.heading: north
northeastern_sea.composition: Open sea looking north. Centre-right midground: the black-sailed galleon at anchor; to its right, a tiny sandy islet with a palm tree. Calm deep-blue water, a distant horizon.

south_coast.heading: east
south_coast.composition: On a clifftop path along the southern coast, looking east. Left: green coastal meadow with a dead red tree; inland, the terraced cliffs of the central plateau. Right: the cliff edge drops to a channel of sea; across it, the towering white wall of the glacier island.

glacier_bottom.heading: north
glacier_bottom.composition: At the foot of the glacier, looking north up its terraces: walls of pale blue ice cliffs, snowfields with dark stone obelisks and a bare dead tree, small purple frost flowers. Far: the green main island across the sea.

glacier_top.heading: north
glacier_top.composition: On the glacier summit, looking north. Foreground: a frozen moat ringed with ice crystals around a small snowy islet with a golden ankh-shaped shrine. Beyond the glacier's ice-cliff edge and across a channel: the green main island, its swamp, meadows and the central plateau.

icy_coast_south.heading: north
icy_coast_south.composition: From the sea off the glacier island's south coast, looking north at it: jagged blue ice cliffs rising from turquoise water, snowfields above with dark stone pillars, and a camp with a campfire and wooden barricades at the mouth of an ice cave.

unknown_islands.heading: east
unknown_islands.composition: Turquoise shallows dotted with small flat sandbar islets: one with a single tall orange sunflower, another with a campfire. Calm clear water, open-sea horizon.

deserted_island.heading: northeast
deserted_island.composition: From the water, looking at a tiny deserted island: pale sand, two red-leaved palm trees, a large wooden treasure chest. The black-sailed galleon anchored to its left, the white-sailed ship to its right.

mountain_forest2.heading: southwest
mountain_forest2.composition: Upper mountain forest by a river, looking southwest. Foreground: thick pine canopy. Midground: a blue river pool with lily pads winding between grassy banks, lavender-grey rock, a stone pillar. Far: across the sea, the glacier island.

dragon_shrine_grounds.heading: north
dragon_shrine_grounds.composition: Looking north across the grounds of the ruined dragon shrine: crumbling grey stone walls with arched windows, broken pillars, stone dragon statues flanking a golden ankh, a ruined stone building with a blue tiled roof on the right, ivy and red flowers everywhere. Beyond, forest and the northern sea.

mountain_east.heading: west
mountain_east.composition: From the sea east of the main island, looking west at its eastern cliffs: tall lavender-grey rock faces, a waterfall pouring from the cliff into the sea, pine forest on top. To the left, the south coast and a glimpse of the glacier island.

waterfall.heading: north
waterfall.composition: At the foot of a waterfall in mountain forest, looking north: a wide waterfall dropping over lavender-grey cliffs into a pool, a winding blue river above with lily pads, pines along the ledges, and the ruined shrine's stone building visible on the right-hand ledge.

ice_spring.heading: north
ice_spring.composition: Close to a frozen spring on a small ice island, looking north: a still pool of turquoise water ringed by ice crystals in the foreground, snowfields and small purple frost plants around it. Across a channel, the main island's south cliffs, green on top.

eastern_sea.heading: west
eastern_sea.composition: Open sea looking west at the main island's east coast: low grassy cliffs, the ruined shrine with grey stone walls and a blue-roofed building, forest and a river behind it, the central plateau rising in the middle distance.

icy_mountain_top.heading: east
icy_mountain_top.composition: On a high snowy plateau of the glacier island, looking east: an open snowfield, dark stone pillars and fallen columns, ice ridges and blue ice cliffs dropping toward the sea on the left; the green main island on the horizon.

icy_mountain.heading: north
icy_mountain.composition: Snowy slopes of the glacier island, looking north: terraced snowfields, blue ice cliffs, dark stone pillars lining a path, ice boulders, a lit torch. Far: the sea and the main island.

cold_waters.heading: south
cold_waters.composition: On cold, choppy turquoise water between islands, looking south. Right: the towering ice cliffs of the glacier island. Left: distant sandbar islets. Pale overcast sky.

southeastern_sea.heading: southwest
southeastern_sea.composition: Open sea looking southwest: a cluster of flat sandbars in turquoise shallows in the midground, and the white edge of the glacier island on the far right.

ice_spring_island.heading: north
ice_spring_island.composition: On a small ice island, looking north from its southern snowfield: a rim of blue ice cliffs and drifts in the foreground, frost plants. Across a channel, the long south coast of the main island: lavender-grey cliffs with green grass on top.

pleasure_island.heading: east
pleasure_island.composition: On Pleasure Island, looking east across its plateau: grass with a red-earth clearing, red palm trees, flaming stone torches, cliff edges dropping away on both sides. Across the water on the right, the long north beach of the main island.

northeast.heading: northwest
northeast.composition: On the north-east headland, looking northwest: a grassy coast with the commanders' red canvas tent and a stone well, the forest edge on the left. Beyond, the sea with two ships and a sandy islet.

moods.clear: bright clear late-morning light, soft shadows, a few white clouds
moods.overcast: soft overcast light, muted colours, low grey clouds
moods.drizzle: grey overcast sky, light drizzle, damp muted colours
moods.storm: dark storm, lightning, heavy rain, dramatic contrast
moods.crisp: crisp cold clear light, pale blue sky, sparkling snow
moods.sunset: warm sunset, pink and orange sky, long shadows

world.Sylvie's cottage: a cottage with white stone walls, a bright red rounded roof and blue-framed windows
world.Pleasure Island: a small tropical island ringed by sheer lavender-grey cliffs, with red-leaved palm trees and stone torches on top
world.the central plateau: terraced lavender-grey stone cliffs with grassy ledges and pine forest, rising in the middle of the main island
world.Veres' mesa: a flat-topped mound of brown earth with grass on top
world.the red extractor: an industrial machine with a teal roof and a red body standing on the beach, with a dark metal pipe scaffold running out into the sea
world.the ruined dragon shrine: grey stone walls and pillars with stone dragon statues, overgrown with ivy
world.the glacier island: an island of white snowfields and tiers of pale-blue ice cliffs, with dark stone pillars
world.the black-sailed galleon: a large wooden galleon with black sails
world.the white-sailed ship: a smaller wooden ship with white sails

palette: vivid green grass, lavender-grey rock, pale sand, deep-blue sea with turquoise shallows
